name: e-Regr
summary: e-Regr is an Expert Advisor that trades based on linear regression channel analysis, entering positions when price deviates from the regression line and reverts back toward it. It uses the regression channel to identify overextended price moves and capitalizes on the statistical tendency of prices to return to their mean. The EA systematically opens buy or sell trades when price touches or crosses the regression channel boundaries.
summary_zh: e-Regr是一个基于线性回归通道分析的智能交易系统，当价格偏离回归线后向均值回归时进场交易。它利用回归通道识别过度延伸的价格走势，并利用价格回归均值的统计趋势获利。当价格触及或穿越回归通道边界时，该EA系统性地开仓买入或卖出。
strategy_analysis: e-Regr策略的核心概念是线性回归通道的均值回归原理，即价格在统计学上倾向于回归到线性回归均值线附近。入场条件为：当价格触及或突破回归通道的上轨时做空，触及或突破下轨时做多，预期价格将回归至通道中线。出场条件包括价格回到回归中线时平仓，或触及止损/止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA允许通过参数调整手数大小，但具体是否采用固定手数或动态仓位需根据参数设定。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置功能，但需注意均值回归策略在强趋势行情中可能面临连续亏损的风险。整体策略逻辑依赖于回归通道周期参数的正确设置，不同市场条件下需要调整参数以适应波动率变化。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the e-Regr strategy is the mean reversion principle based on linear regression channels, relying on the statistical tendency of prices to revert toward the linear regression mean line. Entry conditions are: when price touches or breaks above the upper regression channel band, a sell position is opened; when price touches or breaks below the lower band, a buy position is opened, with the expectation that price will revert to the channel midline. Exit conditions include closing positions when price returns to the regression midline, or when stop-loss/take-profit levels are hit. Position sizing is configurable through lot size parameters, though the EA appears to use fixed lot sizing rather than dynamic allocation based on account equity. Money management incorporates stop-loss settings, but traders should be aware that mean reversion strategies face the risk of consecutive losses during strong trending markets. The overall strategy logic depends heavily on correct regression channel period settings, and parameters need adjustment to adapt to changing market volatility conditions.

pros: 基于线性回归的均值回归策略具有统计学理论基础，逻辑严谨
回归通道能动态适应价格趋势变化，比静态支撑阻力位更灵活
设有止损止盈参数，提供了基本的风险控制机制
pros_en: Mean reversion strategy based on linear regression has a solid statistical foundation with rigorous logic
Regression channels dynamically adapt to price trend changes, offering more flexibility than static support/resistance levels
Stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide a basic risk control mechanism
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中可能遭受重大亏损，价格可能长期不回归
固定手数的仓位管理方式未考虑账户资金变化，存在过度杠杆风险
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
cons_en: Mean reversion strategies can suffer significant losses during strong trending markets where price may not revert for extended periods
Fixed lot sizing does not account for account equity changes, posing over-leveraging risk
Lack of new bar check mechanism may lead to repeated trade entries on the same bar, causing over-trading
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR波动率调整手数大小
添加趋势过滤机制，在强趋势行情中暂停均值回归交易以避免逆势亏损
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on account equity and ATR volatility
Implement a trend filter mechanism to pause mean reversion trading during strong trending markets and avoid counter-trend losses

risk_points: 均值回归策略在单边趋势市场中面临持续逆势亏损风险
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓
固定手数未与账户资金挂钩，资金管理不够灵活
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy faces sustained counter-trend loss risk in one-directional trending markets
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same signal
Fixed lot size is not linked to account equity, making money management inflexible
